summary: A checkout progress track where completed steps collapse into clickable one-line answers, the current step is a filled pill and future steps are numbered ticks, with a narrow "n/total" plus segmented bar layout below 420px, shown in a demo that plays itself once.
by: opus, checked by sonnet, revised by opus, corrected by sonnet from a judge's measurements of the original

items.behaviour: Before the autoplay script acts, the demo is on step 1 of 4 in the wide layout with no completed steps.
items.trigger: initial render, checked within the first 600ms of the card being in view, or after stopping autoplay by pressing on a non-interactive part of the card (for example the heading)
items.expect: Track shows (en) a filled pill containing '1' at 70% opacity and 'Review order', then three empty-circle ticks reading 2, 3, 4. Below: heading 'Review order', note 'Linen tote ×1, canvas pouch ×1. Total NT$1,280 including tax.', full-width button 'Continue to delivery'. The ink line under the track is filled only under the first step. Base text size of the track is 13px.

items.behaviour: Original site demo only (the useDemoAutoplay helper; a port that drops the autoplay skips this item). The demo plays a scripted run once when it scrolls into view: an arrow cursor clicks the main button twice, clicks the completed pickup answer, then clicks the main button again, and the run ends on Payment. A real press or key inside the card stops it.
items.trigger: Original demo with motion on: load the page with the card in view and wait; in a second run, press anywhere inside the card while the script is playing
items.expect: Measured from load, the step changes happen at about 1.6s (step 2, 'Continue to delivery'), 3.4s (step 3, 'Continue to payment'), 5.9s (back to step 2 by clicking the completed '7-Eleven 信義店 pickup' answer) and 8.2s (step 3 again), so the gaps are about 1.8s, 2.5s and 2.3s. The script's own waits of 600ms, 1.1s, 1.3s and 1.1s do not include cursor travel (0.4 to 0.9s), the 120ms dwell and the press. The cursor is gone at about 9.0s; final state is Payment with steps 1 and 2 done. The timer pauses while the card is out of view or the tab is hidden and resumes where it left off. A real pointerdown or keydown inside the card stops the script at once, the cursor fades out in about 0.12s and the step stays where it was. The cursor is hidden from assistive tech and does not take pointer events. The script never runs a second time without a reload.

items.behaviour: Each step renders in one of three states by its index relative to current: done (index < current), current (index == current), next (index > current).
items.trigger: initial render and after each step change
items.expect: Current: pill 28px tall, fully rounded, primary background, primary-foreground text, medium weight, step number at opacity 0.7 then the name, no wrapping. Next: 20px circle with a 1px border, number in 11px muted text. Done: a 12px check icon (stroke 1.5) plus the summary text in muted colour. Each step cell is 40px tall. In the wide track only the current pill uses the primary colour.

items.behaviour: In the wide layout a completed step is the only kind of step that can shrink; its answer is capped at 9rem and cut with an ellipsis when it does not fit, while the pill and ticks keep their full size.
items.trigger: Advance to step 3 in each demo locale, then narrow the container to just above 420px
items.expect: Each completed answer button is at most 144px wide (9rem) including its check; text that overflows ends in an ellipsis on one line (for example the en '7-Eleven 信義店 pickup' or ja 'セブン 信義店で受取' may be cut). As the container narrows, completed answers shrink first; the current pill text never wraps or truncates and the 20px ticks never shrink. The button's title tooltip is the step name, not the answer, and the full answer stays in its accessible name.

items.behaviour: The main demo button advances one step and the completed step collapses into its answer.
items.trigger: With autoplay stopped or finished and the demo back on step 1, press 'Continue to delivery', then 'Continue to payment'
items.expect: After first press: step 1 shows a check plus '2 items · NT$1,280', pill reads '2 Delivery', ticks 3 and 4 remain; heading 'Delivery', button 'Continue to payment'. After second press: step 2 shows a check plus '7-Eleven 信義店 pickup', pill reads '3 Payment', tick 4 remains; heading 'Payment', button 'Pay NT$1,280'.

items.behaviour: The demo never goes past the Payment step; repeated presses on the last button change nothing.
items.trigger: On the Payment step, press 'Pay NT$1,280' several times
items.expect: Step stays at 3 of 4 ('3 Payment' pill, tick 4 still shown). 'Confirmation' never becomes current or done. No movement of the track or ink line.

items.behaviour: A completed step is a button that jumps back to that step; later completed steps return to future ticks.
items.trigger: On Payment, click the completed '7-Eleven 信義店 pickup'; then click the completed '2 items · NT$1,280'
items.expect: First click: current becomes Delivery ('2 Delivery' pill), step 3 becomes tick '3', heading 'Delivery', button 'Continue to payment'. Second click: back to step 1 with ticks 2, 3, 4 and button 'Continue to delivery'. Clicking the current pill or a future tick does nothing (they are not interactive).

items.behaviour: Tab stops only on completed-step buttons, left to right, then the main demo button. Current pill, ticks, check icons and the ink line are not focusable.
items.trigger: With autoplay finished or stopped, press Tab repeatedly from before the demo on step 1, step 2 and step 3
items.expect: Step 1: one stop, the main button. Step 2: 'Review order' answer button, then main button. Step 3: 'Review order' answer, 'Delivery' answer, then main button. Each completed button shows a 2px ring in the ring colour on keyboard focus; the main button shows a 2px ring with a 2px offset.

items.behaviour: Completed-step buttons and the main button activate with Enter and Space.
items.trigger: Focus the 'Delivery' answer button on step 3 and press Enter (or Space); then focus the main button and press Enter
items.expect: Current moves to Delivery exactly as with a click; the main button then advances to Payment.

items.behaviour: The track is an ordered list named for screen readers and marks the current step.
items.trigger: Inspect the accessibility tree in the wide layout on step 2
items.expect: Exactly one list is exposed, accessible name 'Checkout steps' (zh-TW '結帳步驟', zh-CN '结账步骤', ja '購入手続きのステップ'). Exactly one item exposes aria-current='step' and it is the 'Delivery' item. Future ticks expose the step name (for example 'Payment'), not the bare number; the visible digit is hidden from assistive tech. The ink line is hidden.

items.behaviour: A completed-step button has a full spoken name: edit verb, a space, step name, colon, answer, comma, completed word; its tooltip is the step name.
items.trigger: Inspect the completed step 1 button on step 2 in en, zh-TW, zh-CN and ja
items.expect: en name as exposed by Chrome is 'Edit Review order: 2 items · NT$1,280 , completed' (a space before the comma comes from the span boundaries; same in the original and ports), title 'Review order'. zh-TW '修改 確認訂單：2 件 · NT$1,280，已完成'. zh-CN '修改 确认订单：2 件 · NT$1,280，已完成'. ja '変更 注文の確認：2点 · NT$1,280，完了'. Non-English locales use the full-width colon and comma and keep the space after the edit verb; a span-boundary space before the comma may also appear there and is acceptable. The check icon is hidden from assistive tech. No live region exists; on a step change the visible heading changes instead.

items.behaviour: Original site demo only (a port demo uses the English entry with locale="en" and has no locale switch, so it skips this item; the component's own strings are covered by a11y-list-names and a11y-done-button-name). All demo copy (step names, summaries, headings, notes, button labels) follows the demo locale.
items.trigger: Original demo: switch the demo locale to zh-TW, zh-CN and ja and step through 1 to 3
items.expect: zh-TW steps '確認訂單, 配送, 付款, 完成', summaries '2 件 · NT$1,280' and '7-11 信義店取貨', buttons '下一步：配送', '下一步：付款', '付款 NT$1,280'. zh-CN steps '确认订单, 配送, 付款, 完成', summaries '2 件 · NT$1,280' and '7-11 信义店自提', buttons '下一步：配送', '下一步：付款', '支付 NT$1,280'. ja steps '注文の確認, お届け, お支払い, 完了', summaries '2点 · NT$1,280' and 'セブン 信義店で受取', buttons 'お届け方法へ進む', 'お支払いへ進む', 'NT$1,280 を支払う'. Headings match the current step name; the narrow counter line shows the localized step name.

items.behaviour: Hovering a completed-step button brightens its text.
items.trigger: Hover the completed 'Review order' answer on step 2
items.expect: Text and check change from muted-foreground to foreground colour with a colour transition; pointer cursor.

items.behaviour: On a step change the track cells resize and the items inside them move with a spring, and the ink line grows or shrinks from the left.
items.trigger: Press the main button on step 1, then click the completed step to go back
items.expect: Only the li cell and its ink line resize with the spring (stiffness 240, damping 30, no fixed duration). The pill, tick and answer inside each cell are position-only layout items: they appear at their final size on the first frame and then only slide, they do not scale. The leftmost step stays anchored. For roughly the first 100ms the moving ticks pass over the right end of the new pill; this is how the original behaves, not a defect. The ink segment under the new current step scales horizontally from 0 to 1 with origin at its left edge using the same spring; going back, the segment of the step that becomes a tick scales from 1 to 0. In the narrow layout the bar segments fill and empty from the left with the same spring.

items.behaviour: With reduced motion all step changes are instant and the autoplay cursor never appears.
items.trigger: Enable prefers-reduced-motion, reload, let autoplay run, then advance and go back by hand
items.expect: No layout morph and no sliding: steps, pill and ticks jump to their new positions; ink line and narrow segments change with duration 0. In the original site demo only, autoplay still changes steps in the same order (step 2, step 3, step 2, step 3), measured at about 0.25s, then +1.11s, +1.30s and +1.11s (the script's plain waits, since there is no cursor travel), but no cursor is shown or moved; a port without autoplay skips this sentence. Final states are identical to the animated version.

items.behaviour: Below a container width of 420px the track is replaced by a counter, a segmented bar and a wrapping list of completed answers.
items.trigger: Render the demo in a container narrower than 420px (for example a 375px viewport) and be on step 3
items.expect: Top line: '3/4' in muted tabular figures then 'Payment' in medium foreground, truncated if long. Below at 8px gap: 4 segments 4px tall, 4px apart, fully rounded on a border-colour track; segments 1 and 2 filled with foreground, segment 3 filled with primary, segment 4 empty. Below at 8px: the two completed answers (check plus summary) in 12px text, wrapping with 12px column and 4px row gaps, still clickable and each up to the full width. At 420px or wider the wide track shows instead; only one layout is visible at a time.

items.behaviour: The narrow layout on steps 1 and 2 shows fewer answers and fewer filled segments.
items.trigger: In a container narrower than 420px, view step 1, then advance to step 2
items.expect: Step 1: '1/4 Review order', only segment 1 filled and in primary, segments 2 to 4 empty, and no visible answers below the bar (the list holds only visually hidden items). Step 2: '2/4 Delivery', segment 1 foreground, segment 2 primary, segments 3 and 4 empty, one visible answer '2 items · NT$1,280' that returns to step 1 when clicked.

items.behaviour: In the narrow layout the counter and bar are hidden from assistive tech, and the list keeps the same name and current marking.
items.trigger: Inspect the accessibility tree in the narrow layout on step 1 and step 3
items.expect: The 'n/4 name' line and the segmented bar are not exposed. Step 3: list named 'Checkout steps' contains the two completed buttons (same names as wide), then visually hidden items 'Payment' (aria-current='step') and 'Confirmation'; Tab order is the two completed buttons then the main demo button. Step 1: the list holds only the four visually hidden items, 'Review order' marked aria-current='step'; Tab reaches only the main button.
